December 7 34.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt,
with thanks, of your letter No. 3796 dated December 1,
1934 regarding the arrival in Shanghai of one Morton
John Polygon.

As requested in your letter, a copy of
his photo has been given to the French Police and
the original photo is returned to you herewith.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

1934年12月7日。

先生：

谨此致谢，确认收到阁下1934年12月1日第3796号来函，关于莫顿·约翰·波利贡（Morton John Polygon）抵达上海一事。

按照阁下函中要求，其照片副本已送交法国巡捕房，原件随函奉还。

J. Van den Berg 先生，
荷兰驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3796.

SHANGHAI, 1 December 1934 .

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you of the arrival at Shanghai of
Morton John POLYCON, probably of Rumanian nationality, born at
Tichnieff, district Moldavinia, Rumania, and apparently a journa-
list by profession.

This person has been ordered to leave the Netherlands Indies,
having been found there without valid admission papers and means
of subsistence.

He was sent to Singapore where his identification papers were
visaed for Shanghai. Polycon left Singapore on the 18th of Novem-
ber as a third class passenger in the s.s. "Hakone Maru", arriving
here on or about 27th November.

He is at present staying at the Salvation Army Hostel, Weiheiwei
Road and stated to have registered with the local Passport and
Registration Office.

It seems to be his intention to write a few articles for the
local press and to sell some of his drawings in order to raise
sufficient money to leave for South America in the course of
next month. He speaks English fairly well and states to speak
Spanish fluently. According to his story he is not allowed to
return to Rumenia on account of the fact that he belongs to the
Anti-King Carol group. His photograph is enclosed herewith with
the kind request to pass it on to the French Police for return
to this office.

$2. Please give a copy of this report
letter and one copy of photograph to
French Police. After that
Return letter done to acknowledge.
MB

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕
Chinese Secretary.

T.P.Givens, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,

P.A. (Br. Br.)
Will you please note,
make 3 copies of photo
and return to me. GPG

D.S.I. Golden. SHANGHAI.

〔签名〕 04/12/14 To copies of photo, please DEC. 4 1934

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA

第3796号。

上海，1934年12月1日。

先生：

谨此通知阁下，莫顿·约翰·波利孔（Morton John POLYCON）已抵达上海。此人可能具有罗马尼亚国籍，出生于罗马尼亚摩尔达维尼亚（Moldavinia）地区的蒂赫尼夫（Tichnieff），职业似为记者。

此人因在荷属东印度被发现时未持有效入境证件且无生计来源，被勒令离开该地。

他被送往新加坡，其身份证明文件在此获签注前往上海。波利孔于11月18日作为三等舱乘客乘坐“箱根丸”号（s.s. "Hakone Maru"）轮船离开新加坡，于11月27日左右抵达此地。

他目前暂住于威海卫路救世军招待所，并称已向本地护照登记处办理登记。

他似乎打算为本地报刊撰写几篇文章，并出售部分画作，以筹集足够资金，于下月期间前往南美洲。他英语说得相当好，并称能流利使用西班牙语。据其陈述，由于他属于反卡罗尔国王（Anti-King Carol）派系，故不被允许返回罗马尼亚（Rumenia）。现随函附上其照片，恳请转交法国巡捕房，以便随后退回本馆。

$2. 请将本报告函件副本及照片一份送交法国巡捕房。此后
回函确认。
MB

此致

敬礼

〔签名〕
中文秘书

T.P. Givens 先生，
警务处副总监，特别分部，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，

P.A. (Br. Br.)
请知悉，
制作照片副本三份
并退还给我。GPG

D.S.I. Golden. 上海。

〔签名〕 1934年12月4日 请附照片副本两份 DEC. 4 1934
RD/
